versions.changelog: v1.3.1 — answers the security audit. The catalog URL a channel points at is now parsed and checked (https only, no credentials, embed hosts pinned to their own platform) before anything is framed or played; hls.js is pinned with Subresource Integrity; frames carry no referrer. The package stops calling itself network-free: permissions now separate the offline scripts from the embed, whose origins and SRI hashes are declared. Install commands are pinned to clawhub@0.23.3 and lygo-tv@1.3.1. The embed page drops its HTML comments and carries a visible what-this-loads section instead. The trigger is scoped with exclusions, allowed-tools is declared, and self_check gained one named rule per finding so none of them can come back quietly.

v1.3.0 — the player itself, to paste. Three lines of HTML run the LYGO TV Ninja player on any site: Rumble room first, ~12,000 channels pulled cross-origin from chatagent.ca/sources/catalog.json, Prev/Next, Sound, branded bar linking home. Ships embed/lygo-tv-embed.html (a whole branded page), vendored lygo-tv-ninja.js/.css for self-hosting, a new 'embed' command, and a self-check that reads the version from SKILL.md instead of hardcoding it. The pointer contract is unchanged: nothing in this package fetches anything.

v1.2.0: Complete ClawHub listing. Official overlapping-circle emblem. Terms and disclaimer URLs in the pointer. Bookmark/install the live player at https://chatagent.ca/sources/. Channel tab always open; public lists after session Terms. Catalog is RESOURCE. Scripts print URLs only — no network, no subprocess, no pirate proxy.
